summary: Iteration 4 — Tested AI Smart Pricing Badge endpoint + UI, real Resend email delivery on /auth/forgot-password, and ran a Session-3 regression sweep. New backend tests: 12/12 pass. Session-3 tests: 29/29 still pass. Frontend PriceBadge renders correctly on listing detail (amber 'سعر مرتفع' card with icon+label+sub) for both anonymous and owner views. Owner actions (edit/republish/mark-sold/delete) and 360° viewer still present. Overall: 100% pass.

minor.issue: When sample size <3, returns 200 with {badge: null, reason: 'عينة غير كافية للمقارنة'} — fine, but response shape differs from non-existent (no 'reason' key) which complicates frontend logic. Frontend currently just checks badge truthiness so it's safe, but consider a unified shape.
Quartile computation uses simple index (len/4, 3*len/4) which is biased on small samples (e.g., 9 items). Median-based or numpy.percentile would be more robust. Acceptable for MVP.
No caching — every listing-detail page hit re-runs the aggregation query. For high-traffic listings, consider in-memory TTL cache (e.g., 60s) keyed by category+country+subcategory.

Real email is dispatched even if email-existence is unknown (when a real user exists). Server log line '[PWD-RESET] {email} sent={email_sent}' leaks email-existence in logs. Consider redacting or hashing email in logs.
No rate limit. Could be abused to spam Resend quota (free tier 100/day). Add per-IP/per-email rate limit (e.g., 3/hour).

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' likely still present (not re-verified this iter — main agent should add key={l.id}).

issues: Amber ('high') variant uses bg-amber-500/15 + text-amber-600 which provides decent contrast on white — verified visually. No issues.

action_items: Optional: add per-IP rate limit on POST /api/auth/forgot-password (Resend free tier = 100/day).
Optional: redact email in [PWD-RESET] log line to avoid email-existence leakage in logs.
Optional: add 60s TTL cache on /ai/price-badge to avoid recomputing quartiles on every listing-detail view.
Carry-over from iter 2/3: still add key={l.id} in NearbySection .map().
critical_code_review_comments: Price-badge endpoint correctly excludes the listing itself from sample (id: {$ne: listing_id}), filters status=active+moderation=approved, and scopes by country+subcategory when present — well-designed.
Test confirmed: TEST 360 listing (price 50,000 SAR, samples=9, market avg 19,999) classifies as 'high' with color=amber + icon=⚡ — math is correct (50,000 > p75 of 19,999 distribution).

Resend integration: real key 're_c8aZVGYn...' verified working — POST /forgot-password for obaid08642@gmail.com returns email_sent=true with dev_reset_link=null. For admin@harajplus.com (non-key-owner), returns email_sent=false + valid /reset-password?token=... link. Behavior matches Resend free-tier restriction documented in PRD.
PriceBadge.js correctly handles null badge ({badge: null} → returns null component) and chip vs full variant. Color mapping uses tailwind dark-mode-aware classes.
ListingDetail.js:195 only renders <PriceBadge> when listing.price truthy — prevents API call for free listings.
Owner actions still gated on user.id === listing.user_id (verified by login as admin who owns the test listing — all 4 owner buttons appear).
Console: no React errors observed on listing detail page during owner-view session.
Note (informational): server.py is now 1475 lines — approaching 700-line modularity guideline limit by ~2x. Future refactor should split into routers (auth.py, listings.py, ai.py, chat.py).
